resources.string: Live your story. One year at a time.
Live a life, make choices, and see where your story goes — one year at a time.

Your achievements carry over to your next life.

Leisure on Actions boosts mood — pick something that fits your age.
Savings and investments grow over Age Ups on the Assets Markets tab.
